summary: Master FX hedging and currency risk management for pension funds. Learn to protect global portfolios and optimize returns. Enroll at TrainingCred.com.
lede: Currency risk management for global pension investments helps pension fund investment, treasury and risk professionals address exchange-rate exposure in retirement portfolios. Participants learn to map and measure multi-currency exposure, compare hedging approaches, and align currency decisions with liabilities while reporting risk and performance clearly to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the financial integrity and strategic growth of large-scale retirement funds and institutional portfolios.
modules: Global Pension Landscape and Currency Dynamics
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of investment management principles and basic financial derivatives. Experience with Excel-based financial modeling is required. No prior programming or coding knowledge is necessary, as all technical exercises utilize standard analytical platforms and templates provided during the course.
